activation_gates: Verify the exact CRM organization, Development hosts, immutable source SHA, and disabled Production state before rendering any placeholder.
Prove caller-specific Connections expose only the required API Gateway and private authentication headers.
Disable both existing Open Free-Test Setup controls and independently read back that neither control has a direct CRM Function binding before publishing either URL-returning function revision.
Publish and read back the exact Button-category function metadata and module-specific Client Scripts while both replacement controls remain disabled; retain the contained predecessor unchanged.

Bind each disabled replacement control to only its reviewed module-specific Client Script, prove the exact layout, profile, module, event, source, and no-direct-Function binding, then pass one ZZZ SYNTHETIC Development ZDK function-execution canary for each module-specific Client Script; enable each control only after its own exact function category, state, return type, arguments, details.output response, and navigation readback succeeds.
Run the ZZZ SYNTHETIC Form 1 and mandatory Form 2 journeys, approval, expected fail-closed activation, and idempotent never-active rollback canaries before widening access.
rollback: Disable every replacement control instance for the three approved visible labels before restoring any predecessor function revision, and preserve their audit evidence.
Independently read back that both Open Free-Test Setup controls are disabled and have no direct binding to a URL-returning CRM Function.
Restore the retained Form 1 predecessor control as the only visible launcher if replacement validation fails.
Keep Catalyst deployment rows stopped and preserve every configuration, receipt, and route readback.
Never delete historical CRM, Form, Catalyst, or Retell evidence as rollback.
